messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The scheduler's previous single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-13]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- As a follow-up to INC-2026-009, the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- On 2025-06-13, the Ember team decided the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-13]
- As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- On 2026-03-09, Team Atlas observed that the scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2]
- The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- INC-2026-009 happened because two leaders were elected on the scheduler during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-05]
- The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]

Question: Which service depends on the scheduler?

message.reasoning:
The question asks which service depends on the scheduler. Looking through the memory:

- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings.
- The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.
- The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.
- The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails.

Nothing says any service depends on the scheduler. So the answer is "I don't know".
